rejects.event: Gregory of Tours restored a cathedral destroyed by a fire in the city.
rejects.quote: In the 6th century, Gregory of Tours, author of the Ten Books of History, restored a cathedral destroyed by a fire in 561.

rejects.event: The city suffered massive destruction and became the temporary government seat.
rejects.quote: From 10 to 13 June 1940, Tours was the temporary seat of the French government before its move to Bordeaux.
rejects.why: The source states it was the temporary government seat from 10 to 13 June 1940, but does not mention massive destruction.
